title: G3O Procurement Institution Review Queue
description: Where a procurement record waits while its institution is unresolved. Created 2026-08-04 on PI ruling Q5c: institution_link holds RESOLVED uids only, so anything short of a confirmed match lives here instead. A row leaves this queue in one of two ways - a reviewer confirms a candidate, which writes an institution_link row, or a reviewer rejects it, which closes the row with no link. Nothing is deleted.

record_id.description: Join key to the staged procurement record.

country_iso3.description: Tier-0 blocking key. Non-negotiable precondition for every tier (spec section 5).

buyer_name_raw.description: The buyer name exactly as the source wrote it, original script preserved. Never transliterated - the master keeps native names too (row 1 is the Arabic-script Afghan central bank), and routing either side through English loses on both.

buyer_national_id.description: Kept for completeness; tier 2 is unmatchable - see below.

reason.description: Why this could not be auto-resolved. 'subnational_without_corroboration' is the spec section 5 rule: the master is ~719k rows and dozens of same-named municipalities per country is normal. 'tier2_unmatchable' records the structural gap confirmed by the PI on 2026-08-04 - the master carries no national registry identifier, so tier 2 can never fire; acquiring registry IDs would be a new source, barred by the 28 July ruling.

candidates.description: Institutions considered, best first. A legitimately ambiguous name produces several: the master's own key layer documents five DISTINCT US school districts all named 'Clay County' that the registry cannot separate, so an exact-name hit is not by itself an identification.

status.description: 'confirmed' means a reviewer picked a candidate and an institution_link row now exists. 'rejected' means no institution in the master corresponds; the record keeps its staged row and never enters contract-conformant output.

chosen_institution_uid.description: Set only when status is 'confirmed'. Must equal the institution_uid on the institution_link row written from this decision.

master_build_id.description: The master build the candidates were drawn from, e.g. 'mb-2026-07-30'. A decision is only auditable against the build it was made on: 745 uids went 'absent' between the 07-28 and 07-30 builds.
